verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships autonomous multi-agent execution primitives: programmatic `agent.run(task=...)`, team patterns (RoundRobin, Selector, Swarm, GraphFlow, MagenticOne), and AutoGen Studio options to export teams to Python, expose them as endpoints, or run them in a Docker container. Together these let a developer build autonomous workflows that could be deployed to run headlessly. However, background automation (scheduling, triggers, long-running daemons) is left to the user to build with external infrastructure. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron or event triggers, documented background/daemon execution mode, monitoring of unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration of background automation.
